stem: If water ____ to one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level, it boils and turns into steam.
explain_zh: 零條件句講科學事實，if 子句和主句都用現在式，所以被動要用 is heated 搭配主句的 boils。was heated 指過去單一事件，would be heated 是第二條件句，had been heated 是第三條件句，都和「恆常事實」不合。記法：事實用「現在＋現在」。

stem: If students ____ enough sleep, their memory works far better during morning examinations.
explain_zh: 主句 works 是現在式，代表這是通則，屬於零條件句，if 子句也必須用現在式 get。will get 不能放在 if 子句裡，would get 與 had got 分別是第二、第三條件句的形式。記法：零條件句兩邊都現在式。

stem: If the typhoon ____ tomorrow morning, the school will cancel all outdoor activities immediately.
explain_zh: 第一條件句講未來可能發生的事，if 子句用現在簡單式代替未來式，主句才用 will。中文說「如果明天到」很容易誤寫成 will arrive，但 if 子句裡不放 will。would arrive 與 had arrived 是與事實相反的語氣，不符合這裡的真實可能性。

stem: If you hand in the report before this Friday, the teacher ____ you extra credit points.
explain_zh: if 子句用現在式 hand in，代表真實可能的未來，主句就用 will give。would give 屬於與現在事實相反的第二條件句，would have given 是與過去相反的第三條件句，will have given 是未來完成式，語意都不對。

stem: Unless we ____ the leaking pipe today, the water bill will double by next month.
explain_zh: unless 等於 if...not，同樣屬於條件副詞子句，要用現在式 fix 代替未來式。will fix 不能出現在條件子句中，fixed 與 would fix 則把真實條件變成與事實相反的假設，和主句 will double 不搭。

stem: If the app ____ working again during the exam, I will submit my assignment by email instead.
explain_zh: 主句是 will submit，屬於第一條件句，if 子句必須用現在式 stops。will stop 犯了「條件句裡放 will」的常見錯誤；would stop、had stopped 都是假設語氣，和真實可能的情況不符。

stem: If I ____ you, I would apologize to your partner before the group presentation tomorrow.
explain_zh: 第二條件句表達與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞一律用 were，主句搭配 would + 原形。am 是真實現在式，will be 不能放在 if 子句，had been 是與過去相反的第三條件句。記法：If I were you 是固定建議句型。

stem: If our town had a proper bike lane, far more residents ____ to work every day.
explain_zh: if 子句用過去式 had，表示與現在事實相反，主句就要用 would + 原形 cycle。will cycle 用在真實條件句，cycled 少了 would，would have cycled 是與過去相反的講法，時間點都對不上。

stem: If she ____ a little more confident, she would volunteer to give the opening speech.
explain_zh: 主句用 would volunteer，可知是與現在事實相反的第二條件句，if 子句的 be 動詞要用 were。is 是真實現在式，would be 不會出現在 if 子句，had been 屬於與過去相反的假設。

stem: If the government ____ tuition fees next year, thousands of families would struggle to pay.
explain_zh: 主句是 would struggle，代表說話者把這件事當成不太可能發生的假設，因此 if 子句要用過去式 raised。raises 會變成真實的第一條件句，主句就得改成 will struggle；had raised 是與過去相反；would raise 不能放進 if 子句。

stem: What would you do if your flight ____ cancelled only two hours before departure?
explain_zh: 主句用 would you do，屬於與現在或未來事實相反的假設，被動語態要用 were cancelled。is 是真實情況，will be 不能放在 if 子句，had been 會把時間拉到過去，與 would do 不一致。

stem: If we ____ the earlier train, we would not have missed the opening of the ceremony.
explain_zh: 主句是 would not have missed，屬於與過去事實相反的第三條件句，if 子句必須用過去完成式 had caught。caught 只是單純過去式，would catch 不能放在 if 子句，have caught 是現在完成式，都無法表達「當時沒趕上」的懊悔。

stem: If the coach had rested the injured player, the team ____ the championship last season.
explain_zh: if 子句用 had rested，是與過去事實相反，主句要用 would/could/might + have + 過去分詞，所以 might have won 正確。might win 與 would win 指向現在或未來，had won 不能當主句動詞。

stem: If I had known about the scholarship deadline, I ____ my application two weeks earlier.
explain_zh: had known 說明這是與過去事實相反的第三條件句，主句固定用 would have + 過去分詞。would send 指現在或未來，had sent 是條件子句的形式，will have sent 是未來完成式，都與「當時不知道」的懊悔語氣不合。

stem: The fire ____ so quickly if the old warehouse had been fitted with proper sprinklers.
explain_zh: if 子句用 had been fitted，是與過去事實相反，主句要用 would not have spread。would not spread 是與現在相反，had not spread 屬於條件子句用法，will not spread 是未來式，時間都錯。

stem: If the villagers ____ warned in time, nobody would have been trapped by the flood.
explain_zh: 主句 would have been trapped 指出這是與過去事實相反，被動的條件子句要用 had been warned。were warned 是與現在相反，would be 不能放在 if 子句，have been 是現在完成式。

stem: If I had studied biology in high school, I ____ a medical researcher now.
explain_zh: 這是混合條件句：條件在過去（had studied），結果落在現在（now），所以主句用 would + 原形 be。would have been 把結果也放回過去，和 now 衝突；will be 是真實未來；had been 不能當主句。

stem: If she were not afraid of heights, she ____ the observation deck with us yesterday.
explain_zh: 這是混合條件句：條件是「她現在就是怕高」這個持續狀態，結果卻發生在 yesterday，所以主句用 would have visited。would visit 指現在或未來，had visited 是條件子句形式，最後一個選項語序錯誤。

stem: If we had bought the tickets last week, we ____ in this endless queue right now.
explain_zh: 條件在過去（last week），結果在現在（right now），屬於混合條件句，主句用 would + be + Ving。would not have stood 把結果也拉回過去，與 right now 矛盾；其餘兩個缺少 would，無法表達與事實相反。

stem: If he were a more careful driver, he ____ into that lamp post last Saturday night.
explain_zh: 條件描述他「一向不小心」這個現在的性格，結果卻是上週六的具體事件，因此主句用 would not have crashed。would not crash 指現在或未來，had not crashed 是條件子句形式，did not crash 只是陳述事實，沒有假設語氣。

stem: I wish I ____ how to swim; then I could join the diving course this summer.
explain_zh: wish 後面表達與現在事實相反的願望，動詞要退一格用過去式 knew。know 是直述現在事實，have known 是現在完成式，would know 在此不合語法。記法：wish + 過去式＝現在辦不到。

stem: She wishes she ____ the email before deleting it, because it contained her exam results.
explain_zh: wish 表達與「過去」事實相反的後悔時，要用過去完成式 had read。read 只表示與現在相反，would read 用於抱怨對方的習慣，has read 是現在完成式，都無法表達已經刪掉的懊悔。

stem: If only the museum ____ photography, I could have recorded that amazing dinosaur skeleton.
explain_zh: If only 和 wish 用法相同；主句 could have recorded 指過去，所以條件要用過去完成式 had allowed。allowed 是與現在相反，allows 是真實現在式，would allow 則用於請求對方改變，語氣都不對。

stem: If only my roommate ____ so loudly every night, I would get a decent night's rest.
explain_zh: If only 表達與現在事實相反的願望，動詞退一格用過去式 did not snore，主句才會是 would get。does not snore 是直述現在事實，had not snored 與 has not snored 都把時間拉到過去，和 every night 的現況不符。

stem: She orders everyone around as if she ____ the manager, although she joined only last month.
explain_zh: as if 後面表示與現在事實相反的比喻時，be 動詞用 were。is 會變成陳述事實，等於承認她真的是經理；has been 與 had been 把時間往前推，和 although 後面的現況不搭。

stem: The old house looked as if it ____ empty for decades, with broken windows and thick dust.
explain_zh: 主要動詞 looked 是過去式，as if 子句要描述「更早之前」的狀態，所以用過去完成式 had stood。stood 表示與過去同時，has stood 的現在完成式和 looked 不一致，would stand 沒有比較時間先後的功能。

stem: ____ your timely advice, I would have signed that contract without reading the small print.
explain_zh: But for 等於 If it had not been for，表示「要不是有…」，後面接名詞並搭配 would have + 過去分詞。But that 後面要接子句，Except for 只是「除了」沒有假設意味，Unless for 不是正確的用法。

stem: But for the volunteers' quick response, the wildfire ____ the whole national park.
explain_zh: But for 引導與過去事實相反的假設，主句要用 would have + 過去分詞。would destroy 指現在或未來，had destroyed 是條件子句的形式，will destroy 是真實未來，都無法表達「幸好沒有燒掉」。

stem: ____ a reliable internet connection, the online lecture would have been impossible to follow.
explain_zh: Without 加名詞等於 If there had not been，可以引導與過去事實相反的假設。Unless 後面必須接子句，Despite 是「儘管」語意相反，Instead of 是「而不是」，都無法構成條件。

stem: Without the scholarship, she ____ able to afford the exchange programme in Vancouver next year.
explain_zh: next year 說明結果在未來，Without 引導與現在或未來事實相反的假設，主句用 would not be。would not have been 指過去，will not be 是真實未來沒有假設語氣，had not been 不能當主句動詞。

stem: ____ down the corridor, the new student suddenly heard someone calling her English name.
explain_zh: 分詞構句的主詞就是主句的 the new student，她是「主動走」，所以用現在分詞 Walking。Walked 是被動或過去式，To walk 表示目的，Walk 是原形動詞，都不能連接兩個句子。

stem: ____ by heavy rain, the annual sports meeting was postponed until the following Saturday.
explain_zh: 運動會是「被」大雨耽誤，主詞與動作是被動關係，要用過去分詞 Delayed。Delaying 是主動，Having delayed 也是主動且強調先後，To delay 表示目的，語意都相反。

stem: ____ his homework, Kevin went straight to the basketball court behind the library.
explain_zh: 先寫完功課才去球場，兩個動作有明顯先後，用完成式分詞 Having finished 最精準。Have finished 是原形動詞不能開頭，Finished 會變成被動，To finish 則表示目的。

stem: ____ in 1908, the wooden chapel is now the oldest building on our campus.
explain_zh: 小教堂是「被」建造的，用過去分詞 Built 表示被動。Building 是主動，會變成「教堂蓋了什麼」；To build 表目的；Having built 是主動完成式，主詞關係不合。

stem: The students sat in the hall, ____ carefully to the professor's explanation of climate models.
explain_zh: 逗號後接分詞構句表示同時進行的動作，學生是主動聽，所以用 listening。listened 會造成兩個動詞並列卻沒有連接詞，listen 是原形，to listen 表示目的而非同時發生。

stem: ____ what to say next, the nervous candidate stared at the interviewer in complete silence.
explain_zh: 分詞構句的否定要把 not 放在分詞前面，主動關係用現在分詞，所以是 Not knowing。Not known 是被動，Knowing not 語序錯誤，Not to know 是不定詞。記法：not + Ving。

stem: ____ several times by the same virus, the company finally upgraded its whole security system.
explain_zh: 公司是「被」病毒攻擊，而且攻擊發生在升級之前，所以用完成式被動分詞 Having been attacked。Having attacked 與 Attacking 都是主動，Have been attacked 是原形動詞不能引導分詞構句。

stem: The typhoon swept across the island, ____ thousands of households without electricity for two days.
explain_zh: 分詞構句放在句尾表示前面動作造成的結果，颱風是主動造成的，用現在分詞 leaving。left 會讓兩個過去式動詞並列卻沒有連接詞，leave 是原形，to leave 會誤解成颱風的目的。

stem: ____ from the top of Taipei 101, the city looks like a glittering circuit board at night.
explain_zh: 主句主詞是 the city，城市是「被」看的，所以要用過去分詞 Seen。Seeing 會變成城市在看，是典型的分詞主詞錯置；To see 表目的；Having seen 也是主動。

stem: ____ with last year's figures, this month's electricity consumption dropped by nearly fifteen percent.
explain_zh: 用電量是「被」拿來比較的，固定用法是 Compared with/to。Comparing with 會變成主詞主動去比較，To compare 表示目的，Compare 是原形動詞。記法：Compared with... 是固定的開頭語。

stem: ____ that she had failed the interview, Mei spent the whole evening revising her résumé.
explain_zh: 美是主動察覺到這件事，所以用現在分詞 Realizing 引導分詞構句。Realized 與 Being realized 都是被動，語意變成「她被察覺」；To realize 表示目的，也不合邏輯。

stem: A tall man ____ a grey raincoat asked the guard where the lost property office was.
explain_zh: wearing a grey raincoat 是簡化的形容詞子句 who was wearing，修飾前面的 man，用現在分詞表示主動。worn 是被動（雨衣被穿），wear 是原形，to wear 表示目的。

stem: ____ properly, these solar panels can supply a small household with electricity for twenty years.
explain_zh: 太陽能板是「被」安裝的，要用過去分詞 Installed，相當於 If they are installed properly。Installing 與 Having installed 都是主動，To install 表示目的，主詞關係都不對。

stem: The volunteers walked along the riverbank, ____ rubbish into large blue bags.
explain_zh: 志工是主動撿垃圾，且與 walked 同時進行，用現在分詞 collecting。collected 造成動詞並列缺少連接詞，collect 是原形，to collecting 的形式本身就錯。

stem: ____ the difficulty of the task, the committee decided to extend the deadline by one month.
explain_zh: Given 在句首是固定用法，意思是「考慮到、鑑於」，後面接名詞。Giving 是主動給予，To give 表示目的，Gave 是過去式動詞，都不能引導這種獨立說明。

stem: ____ no other choice, the passengers had to spend the night at the airport terminal.
explain_zh: 乘客是主動「沒有其他選擇」，用現在分詞 Having 引導分詞構句，相當於 Since they had no other choice。Had 與 Have 是限定動詞，需要連接詞；To have 表示目的。

stem: ____ badly damaged by the earthquake, the bridge had to be closed for eighteen months.
explain_zh: 橋是「被」地震損壞，而且損壞在封閉之前，完整寫法是 Having been badly damaged。Having 後面接過去分詞會變成主動完成式，To have been 表示目的，Have been 是原形動詞。

stem: ____ the report twice, the manager still could not find the missing figure.
explain_zh: 經理是主動讀，而且讀完在後面的動作之前，用 Having read。Have read 是原形不能開頭，Read 在句首會被當成祈使句或被動，To read 表示目的。

stem: The children ran out of the classroom, ____ and waving their drawings in the air.
explain_zh: 後面的 waving 已經提示要用現在分詞，兩個分詞並列表示同時發生的主動動作，所以填 shouting。shouted 與 waving 形式不一致，shout 是原形，to shout 表示目的。

stem: ____ at the bus stop for almost an hour, Joyce finally decided to walk home in the rain.
explain_zh: 等了將近一小時在「決定走路」之前，用完成式分詞 Having waited 才能凸顯先後與持續。Have waited 是原形，Waited 在句首變成被動，To wait 表示目的。

stem: ____ the strict safety rules, the lab manager refused to let the reporters go inside.
explain_zh: 主管是主動援引規定，用現在分詞 Citing。Cited 是被動，會變成「主管被引用」；To cite 表示目的，Cite 是原形動詞，都不能連接後面的主句。

stem: The letter, ____ in 1943, describes daily life in a small fishing village during the war.
explain_zh: 信是「被」寫的，過去分詞 written 相當於 which was written，插在主詞後面當補充說明。writing 是主動，to write 表示目的，wrote 是過去式動詞會造成兩個動詞並列。

stem: ____ that the machine was overheating, the engineer immediately switched off the main power.
explain_zh: 工程師是主動注意到，用現在分詞 Noticing 表示原因。Noticed 與 Being noticed 都是被動，語意變成工程師被注意到；To notice 表示目的，邏輯不通。

stem: ____ with modern equipment, the old hospital can now handle three times as many patients.
explain_zh: 醫院是「被」配備新設備，用過去分詞 Equipped，等於 Now that it is equipped。Equipping 與 Having equipped 都是主動，To equip 表示目的，主詞關係不合。

stem: Never ____ such a spectacular sunrise as the one we watched on Mount Hehuan.
explain_zh: 否定副詞 Never 放句首時，句子要倒裝，把助動詞移到主詞前面，成為 have I seen。I have seen 沒有倒裝，did I saw 的 did 後面必須接原形，I did see 同樣沒倒裝。

stem: Hardly ____ the station when the announcement about the two-hour delay came over the loudspeaker.
explain_zh: Hardly...when 是固定句型，主句用過去完成式且必須倒裝，寫成 had we reached。we had reached 沒倒裝，did we reached 時態錯誤，we have reached 既沒倒裝時態也不對。記法：Hardly had S Vpp when S Ved。

stem: Not only ____ the competition, but she also broke the national record that same afternoon.
explain_zh: Not only 放句首要部分倒裝，一般動詞就借助動詞 did，並把動詞還原成 win，成為 did she win。she won 與 she did win 都沒有倒裝，won she 的語序在現代英語不成立。

stem: Not only ____ the price reasonable, but the after-sales service is also excellent.
explain_zh: Not only 開頭要倒裝，be 動詞直接移到主詞 the price 前面，所以填 is。it is 沒有倒裝而且多了主詞，does 不能接形容詞補語，has been 會造成時態與語意不合。

stem: Little ____ that his casual remark would start a heated debate across the whole school.
explain_zh: Little 當否定副詞放句首要倒裝，借助動詞 did 並把動詞還原成 know。he knew 與 he did know 都沒倒裝，knew he 是舊式語序，現代英語不用。記法：Little did S know that...。

stem: Little ____ how much effort the volunteers had put into the charity concert that evening.
explain_zh: Little 放句首必須倒裝，現在式一般動詞借 do，成為 do most people realize。most people realize 與 most people do realize 都沒有倒裝，realize most people 語序錯誤。

stem: Seldom ____ such a well-organized exhibition in a small town library before.
explain_zh: Seldom 是否定副詞，放句首要把助動詞 have 移到主詞前面，成為 have I attended。I have attended 沒倒裝，did I attended 時態形式錯誤，I did attend 同樣沒倒裝。

stem: No sooner ____ the front door than the telephone in the living room started ringing.
explain_zh: No sooner...than 是固定句型，前半用過去完成式並倒裝，寫成 had he locked。he had locked 沒倒裝，did he lock 時態不對，he locked 兩者都不符。注意後面配 than，不是 when。

stem: Only after the meeting ended ____ that his proposal had been rejected once again.
explain_zh: Only 加副詞子句放句首時，主句要倒裝，一般動詞借助動詞 did，成為 did Peter realize。Peter realized 與 Peter did realize 都沒倒裝，realized Peter 語序錯誤。注意倒裝的是主句，不是 Only 後面的子句。

stem: Only when we ran out of drinking water ____ how serious the situation really was.
explain_zh: Only when 引導的子句放句首，主句必須部分倒裝，過去式一般動詞借 did 並還原動詞，成為 did we understand。其餘選項都沒有正確倒裝。

stem: Only by practising every single day ____ improve your pronunciation within three months.
explain_zh: Only 加介系詞片語放句首，主句要倒裝，把情態助動詞移到主詞前，成為 can you improve。you can 與 you could 沒有倒裝，could you to 多了 to。

stem: My sister loves horror films, and ____ my two cousins who live in Kaohsiung.
explain_zh: 前句動詞是 loves（一般動詞現在式），後面主詞 my two cousins 是複數，所以用 so do。so are 對應 be 動詞，so does 是單數，neither 用於否定句的附和。

stem: Tom has never been to Penghu, and ____ his parents, though they love island trips.
explain_zh: 前句是否定，附和要用 neither 倒裝；主詞 his parents 是複數，助動詞用 have，所以是 neither have。neither has 主詞動詞不一致，so have 用在肯定句，either 不能這樣放句首倒裝。

stem: I was not satisfied with the hotel, and ____ the other guests on our tour.
explain_zh: 否定的附和用 nor 或 neither 並倒裝，主詞 the other guests 是複數，be 動詞用 were。nor was 單複數不合，so were 用於肯定附和，either were 語法不成立。

stem: At the end of the narrow lane ____ a tiny bookshop that sells second-hand comic books.
explain_zh: 地方副詞片語放句首時要完全倒裝，動詞放在主詞前面；主詞 a tiny bookshop 是單數，所以用 stands。stand 單複數不合，多加 there 會重複，standing 不是限定動詞。

stem: On the wall opposite the entrance ____ two portraits of the school's first principal.
explain_zh: 地方副詞片語開頭的完全倒裝，動詞要配合真正的主詞 two portraits（複數），所以用 hang。hangs 是單數，are hanging there 多了贅字 there，hanging 缺少限定動詞。

stem: Down the hill ____ the excited children, laughing all the way to the village square.
explain_zh: 表示方向的副詞片語放句首、主詞又是名詞時，用完全倒裝，動詞直接放前面，所以是 ran。did run 是部分倒裝，只用於否定副詞開頭；were run 是被動；run they 語序錯誤。

stem: Under no circumstances ____ the emergency exit be blocked by boxes or spare furniture.
explain_zh: Under no circumstances 本身已含否定，句子要倒裝，把 should 移到主詞前面，且不能再加 not 造成雙重否定。it should 沒有倒裝又多了主詞，must to 形式錯誤。

stem: ____ in 2019 that our school started the recycling programme on every floor.
explain_zh: 強調句的固定框架是 It is/was + 被強調部分 + that，時間是 2019 年，所以用 It was。It is 時態不對，That was 與 There was 都不能組成強調句型。

stem: It was the heavy rain ____ ruined our carefully planned barbecue by the riverside.
explain_zh: It is/was...that 強調句中，不論強調的是人、事、物或時間，連接詞都可以用 that。what 不能出現在這個框架裡，when 只用於強調時間副詞且此處後面缺主詞，whom 用於人。

stem: ____ was my grandmother who taught me how to make traditional rice dumplings.
explain_zh: 強調句的主詞位置只能用虛主詞 It，句型是 It was + 人 + who。That was my grandmother 變成單純指認，She was 會和後面的 my grandmother 重複，There was 是存在句。

stem: It is not the price but the quality ____ makes this brand popular among young cyclists.
explain_zh: 強調句用 It is...that，被強調的是 not the price but the quality，所以填 that。what 不能用在強調句，which is 多了動詞造成重複，who 只能指人。

stem: It was only after the final exam ____ Jason remembered he had left his calculator at home.
explain_zh: 被強調的是時間副詞片語 only after the final exam，強調句框架仍然用 that。when 會讓句子變成時間子句而失去強調結構，then 是副詞，which 用來引導關係子句。

stem: It was in the old library ____ the two writers met for the very first time.
explain_zh: 強調地點片語 in the old library 時，強調句仍固定用 that 連接。which 需要在後面的子句中擔任主詞或受詞，這裡子句已完整；what 與 there 都不能用於強調句。

stem: ____ impressed me most was the way the volunteers comforted the frightened children.
explain_zh: 這是 what 引導的名詞子句當主詞的強調用法，What 同時扮演主詞角色，等於 The thing that。That 引導的名詞子句不能缺少成分，It 需要後面接 that 才成立，Which 通常需要先行詞。

stem: It is because of his constant encouragement ____ I finally dared to enter the speech contest.
explain_zh: 強調原因片語 because of his constant encouragement，框架一樣是 It is...that。which 需要先行詞且要在子句中有角色，so 是連接副詞，why 會與 because 重複表達原因。

stem: It ____ the students, not the teachers, who first proposed the campus bike-sharing scheme.
explain_zh: 強調句的 be 動詞永遠配合虛主詞 It，一律用單數，即使被強調的是複數 the students 也一樣，所以用 was。were 是學生最常犯的錯，is being 與 have been 時態語意都不合。

stem: It was not until midnight ____ the rescue team finally reached the trapped hikers.
explain_zh: not until 的強調句型固定是 It was not until... that...，所以填 that。when 會破壞強調結構，then 是副詞，until 會重複。記法：not until 配 that，不配 when。

stem: It was last summer ____ my parents decided to move back to Tainan and open a bookshop.
explain_zh: 強調時間名詞片語 last summer 時，用 It was...that 的框架。when it 多了主詞造成句子結構錯亂，which 需要在子句中有語法角色，what 不能用於強調句。

stem: It is the government, rather than individual drivers, ____ should tackle this air pollution.
explain_zh: 被強調的是 the government，強調句用 that 連接，後面直接接 should tackle。what 不能用於強調句，who it 與 which it 都多了一個主詞，句子會不完整。

stem: ____ you practise speaking English, the more natural your pronunciation will become.
explain_zh: 「越…越…」的句型是 The + 比較級..., the + 比較級...，兩邊都要有 the。More 少了 the，The most 是最高級，As more 不是正確用法。

stem: The harder the team trained, ____ they became about winning the final.
explain_zh: 前半已是 The harder，後半必須對應 the + 比較級；confident 是多音節形容詞，比較級用 more confident，所以是 the more confident。少了 the、用最高級或語序顛倒都不對。

stem: The sooner we book the tickets, ____ we will have to pay for the return flight.
explain_zh: 「越早訂越少錢」中的錢是不可數，比較級用 less，且句型需要 the，所以是 the less。less 少了 the，the least 是最高級，the fewer 用於可數名詞。

stem: ____ the air pollution becomes, the more people suffer from serious breathing problems.
explain_zh: bad 的比較級是不規則的 worse，並且要加 the 構成「越…越…」。Worse 少了 the，The worst 是最高級，The more bad 不是正確的比較級形式。

stem: The longer you stare at the screen, ____ your eyes will feel by the end of the day.
explain_zh: 前半是 The longer，後半必須是 the + 比較級；tired 是雙音節以上的分詞形容詞，比較級用 more tired。少了 the、用最高級或自創 tireder 都是錯的。

stem: The whole three-day trip cost ____ two thousand dollars, which surprised all of us.
explain_zh: no more than 意思是「只不過、才」，強調金額少，符合後面 surprised 的語境。no less than 與 not less than 強調「多達、不少於」，語意相反；no fewer than 用於可數名詞。

stem: He is ____ a scientist than I am a professional singer; he only reads popular science books.
explain_zh: A is no more B than C is D 表示「兩者都不是」，用來否定雙方，符合後半的自嘲語氣。not more 只是比較程度，no less 意思相反變成「兩者都是」，much more 也是單純比較。

stem: ____ three hundred volunteers joined the beach clean-up, far beyond the organizers' expectations.
explain_zh: volunteers 是可數名詞，強調「多達」要用 No fewer than，正好呼應 far beyond expectations。No more than 與 Not more than 是「只不過」語意相反，No less as 形式錯誤。

stem: This second-hand bicycle is ____ good as the brand-new one my cousin bought last month.
explain_zh: 肯定句的同等比較用 as + 原級 + as，所以第一個空要填 as。so...as 只用於否定句，as much 用於不可數名詞的量，such 後面接名詞不接形容詞。

stem: The film was not ____ interesting as the novel, though the photography was truly beautiful.
explain_zh: 否定句可以用 not so + 原級 + as，因為選項沒有 as，答案是 so。as much 用於不可數的量，such 後面接名詞，very 不能和 as 搭配比較。

stem: She speaks Japanese ____ fluently as her mother, who grew up in Osaka many years ago.
explain_zh: 肯定句的同等比較是 as + 副詞原級 + as，所以填 as fluently as。so 只用於否定，more 要配 than，such 不能修飾副詞。

stem: Our new office is ____ as large as the old one, so everyone finally has a proper desk.
explain_zh: 倍數表達的固定語序是「倍數 + as + 原級 + as」，所以用 twice as large as。double 不能這樣接 as...as，two-fold 是形容詞或副詞但不用於此句型，twice more 語意不清。

stem: Of all the sports facilities on campus, the swimming pool is used ____ in winter.
explain_zh: Of all... 表示三者以上的比較，要用最高級 the least。least of 語法不完整，the less 是比較級只能用於兩者，lesser 多用於固定片語如 the lesser evil。

stem: This year's rice harvest is ____ better than last year's, thanks to the new irrigation system.
explain_zh: 修飾比較級 better 要用 far、much、a lot 等副詞，所以選 far。very 只能修飾原級，much more 會和 better 重複比較級，so 不能直接修飾比較級。

stem: The more carefully you check your essay, ____ mistakes the examiner will find in it.
explain_zh: mistakes 是可數名詞，比較級用 fewer，且「越…越…」句型需要 the，所以是 the fewer。the less 用於不可數，fewer 少了 the，the fewest 是最高級。

stem: The hotel was quite expensive; ____, the view from our balcony made it worth every dollar.
explain_zh: 分號前後語意轉折，「很貴」對上「但很值得」，要用表示對比的 however。therefore 表結果，moreover 表補充，otherwise 表「否則」，都接不起這個轉折。

stem: He had studied the map carefully; ____, he still got lost in the old part of town.
explain_zh: 後半有 still，代表「儘管如此還是」的讓步轉折，用 nevertheless 最合適。consequently 與 therefore 表因果，moreover 表補充，都和 still 的語氣衝突。

stem: The bridge was closed for urgent repairs; ____, all the buses had to take a longer route.
explain_zh: 橋封閉是原因，公車繞路是結果，要用表因果的 therefore。however 與 nevertheless 表轉折，otherwise 表「否則」，都不符合前後的因果關係。

stem: The apartment is right next to the MRT station; ____, the rent is surprisingly reasonable.
explain_zh: 兩句都是優點，屬於同方向的補充說明，用 moreover。however 與 nevertheless 表轉折，otherwise 表「否則」，都會讓語意變得矛盾。

stem: She forgot to save the file before the power cut; ____, three hours of work disappeared.
explain_zh: 忘記存檔導致工作消失，是明確的因果關係，用 consequently。nevertheless 與 however 表轉折，moreover 表補充，都無法表達「結果」。

stem: You must leave the office before six; ____, you will be stuck in the evening traffic jam.
explain_zh: otherwise 表示「否則、不然的話」，正好接續前面的警告。therefore 表結果，moreover 表補充，however 表轉折，都無法表達「如果不照做就會…」。

stem: The northern coast is windy and freezing in winter; ____, the south stays mild and sunny.
explain_zh: 南北氣候形成對照，要用 in contrast。as a result 表結果，in addition 表補充，for instance 用來舉例，都不符合兩地相反的比較。

stem: The experiment failed three times in a row; ____, the young researchers refused to give up.
explain_zh: 失敗卻不放棄，是讓步轉折，用 nonetheless（等同 nevertheless）。accordingly 與 thus 表結果，likewise 表相似，都無法表達這種反差。

stem: Online courses are flexible and cheap; ____, they demand a great deal of self-discipline.
explain_zh: 前面講優點，後面講缺點，屬於轉折，用 however。therefore 與 thus 表結果，similarly 表相似，都會讓優缺點的對比消失。

stem: The factory cut its emissions by half; ____, the air in the valley improved noticeably.
explain_zh: 減少排放是原因，空氣變好是結果，用 as a result。on the contrary 表相反，even so 表讓步，in other words 是換句話說，都不合語意。

stem: She is completely fluent in Spanish; ____, she can handle basic conversations in Portuguese.
explain_zh: 兩句都在列舉她的語言能力，屬於補充，用 furthermore。otherwise 表「否則」，nevertheless 表轉折，conversely 表相反，都不符合累加的關係。

stem: The team lost their first two matches badly; ____, they went on to win the championship.
explain_zh: 輸了兩場卻仍奪冠，是「即使如此」的讓步轉折，用 even so。therefore 表結果，likewise 表相似，in addition 表補充，都無法呈現這種逆轉。

stem: Many people assume cycling is dangerous; ____, it is safer than driving in most cities.
explain_zh: 後半直接推翻前面的看法，用 on the contrary（正好相反）。consequently 表結果，moreover 表補充，meanwhile 表同時，都無法表達「事實恰恰相反」。

stem: The head chef prepared the sauce; ____, his assistant chopped vegetables for the salad.
explain_zh: 兩件事同時進行，用 meanwhile（與此同時）。therefore 表結果，nevertheless 表轉折，otherwise 表「否則」，都無法表達時間上的並行。

stem: Paper straws often break within minutes; ____, many restaurants have quietly switched back.
explain_zh: 吸管易斷是原因，餐廳換回去是結果，用 thus。however 表轉折語意相反，instead of 是介系詞後面要接名詞，although 是從屬連接詞不能放在分號後單獨使用。

stem: All the tickets sold out within an hour; ____, the organizers added two extra performances.
explain_zh: 票秒殺因此加場，是因果關係，accordingly 表示「因此、相應地」。otherwise 表「否則」，in contrast 表對照，nevertheless 表轉折，都不合邏輯。

stem: The report was thoroughly researched; ____, it was far too long for a ten-minute talk.
explain_zh: 研究紮實是優點，太長是缺點，兩者形成讓步轉折，用 nevertheless。consequently 表結果，moreover 表補充，similarly 表相似，語意都不通。

stem: Solar panels can reduce electricity bills; ____, they raise the market value of a house.
explain_zh: 兩句都在說太陽能板的好處，屬於補充累加，用 in addition。in contrast 表對照，otherwise 表「否則」，nonetheless 表轉折，都與同方向的列舉不符。

stem: The school network crashed twice last term; ____, students should back up their files regularly.
explain_zh: 當機是原因，備份建議是結論，用 therefore。however 與 in contrast 表轉折或對照，meanwhile 表同時，都無法連接這個推論。

stem: The two candidates share very similar policies; ____, their campaign styles are totally different.
explain_zh: 政見相似卻風格不同，是對比轉折，用 however。hence 表結果，likewise 表「同樣地」，furthermore 表補充，都與 different 的反差衝突。

stem: The renovation plan sounds attractive. ____, it will cost far more than the school can afford.
explain_zh: 這裡是兩個獨立句子，句首要用連接副詞 However 並加逗號。Although 是從屬連接詞，必須把兩句合成一句；Despite 是介系詞後面接名詞；But that 不是這種用法。

stem: The doctor insisted that the patient ____ in bed for at least three more days.
explain_zh: insist 表達「堅持要求」時，that 子句用假設語氣，動詞一律用原形（should 可省略），所以是 stay。stays、stayed、is staying 都是隨主詞或時態變化的直述形式，不符合這個規則。

stem: Our English teacher suggested that we ____ the report in pairs instead of writing it alone.
explain_zh: suggest 表建議時，that 子句用「(should +) 原形動詞」，所以填 do。did 是過去式，does 隨主詞變化，are doing 是進行式，都不是假設語氣的原形。

stem: The manager demanded that every employee ____ the new safety training before Friday.
explain_zh: demand 屬於要求類動詞，that 子句要用原形 complete，即使主詞 every employee 是第三人稱單數也不加 s。completes 是常見的錯誤，completed 與 is completing 時態也不對。

stem: It is essential that every applicant ____ two letters of recommendation with the form.
explain_zh: It is essential/important/necessary that... 這類句型後面同樣用假設語氣原形動詞，所以是 submit。submits 加了第三人稱單數 s，submitted 與 is submitting 時態都不符。

stem: The committee proposed that the old library ____ into a student activity centre.
explain_zh: propose 後面的 that 子句用假設語氣，被動形式就是 be + 過去分詞，所以是 be turned。is turned 與 was turned 是直述被動，turns 是主動且語意不通。

stem: She requested that her name ____ from the list of contributors on the website.
explain_zh: request 屬於要求類動詞，that 子句用原形；被動就寫成 be removed。is removed 與 was removed 都是直述語氣，removes 是主動，語意會變成名字自己移除。

stem: It is important that nobody ____ the laboratory without wearing protective goggles.
explain_zh: It is important that... 後面用假設語氣原形 enter，即使主詞 nobody 看起來是單數也不加 s。enters 是最常見的誘答，entered 與 is entering 時態不合。

stem: The coach recommended that Jason ____ more attention to his breathing while swimming.
explain_zh: recommend 表建議時，that 子句用原形動詞 pay。pays 受主詞 Jason 影響加了 s，paid 是過去式，is paying 是進行式，都不是假設語氣。

stem: The new law requires that every scooter rider ____ a valid licence at all times.
explain_zh: require 屬於要求類動詞，that 子句用原形 carry，不隨主詞變化。carries 是典型錯誤，carried 是過去式，is carrying 是進行式。

stem: His mother insisted that he ____ home before eleven, however exciting the party was.
explain_zh: insist 表示堅持要求，that 子句用原形 come。comes 隨主詞變化，came 是過去式，is coming 是進行式；注意 insist 若是「堅稱某事實」才用直述語氣。

stem: It was necessary that all the documents ____ before the board meeting started.
explain_zh: It was necessary that... 後面仍用假設語氣，被動寫成 be signed，不受主要子句過去式影響。were signed 與 are signed 是直述語氣，have signed 是主動完成式。

stem: The students demanded that the canteen ____ more vegetarian options every single day.
explain_zh: demand 後面的 that 子句用原形 offer，主詞 the canteen 雖是單數也不加 s。offers、offered、is offering 都是直述形式，不符合假設語氣。

stem: I suggest that the meeting ____ until everyone has read the proposal carefully.
explain_zh: suggest 表建議時，被動的 that 子句寫成 be postponed。is postponed 與 was postponed 是直述被動，postpones 是主動，語意變成會議自己延期。

stem: It is vital that the equipment ____ regularly, or the whole system may break down.
explain_zh: It is vital that... 屬於需要假設語氣的句型，被動用 be checked。is checked 與 was checked 都是直述語氣，checks 是主動，設備不會自己檢查。

stem: The judge ordered that the company ____ all the polluted soil within six months.
explain_zh: order 表下令時，that 子句用原形 remove。removes 受主詞影響加了 s，removed 是過去式，is removing 是進行式，都不是假設語氣。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: Mr. Chen, ____ of our school's science club, will give a talk on renewable energy.
explain_zh: 兩個逗號之間放的是同位語，用名詞片語 the founder 直接說明 Mr. Chen。who founder 少了動詞，founding 是分詞，he is the founder 是完整句子會造成兩句相連。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: Taipei, ____ of Taiwan, attracts millions of international visitors every single year.
explain_zh: 同位語直接用名詞片語 the capital 補充說明 Taipei，不需要關係代名詞或動詞。which capital 與 where the capital 結構不完整，is the capital 會讓句子出現兩個主要動詞。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: My best friend Anna, ____, has already published two short stories in an online magazine.
explain_zh: 同位語用名詞片語 a talented writer 說明 Anna 的身分。who talented writer 缺動詞，she is a writer 是獨立句子，being writer 少了冠詞而且語氣不自然。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: We visited Tainan, ____ city in Taiwan, during the long Lunar New Year holiday.
explain_zh: 同位語 the oldest city in Taiwan 補充說明 Tainan，最高級前面要加 the。oldest 少了 the，which oldest 結構錯誤，the older 是比較級只能用於兩者之間。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: Her first novel, ____ book she ever finished, is still popular among teenagers today.
explain_zh: 同位語需要一個完整的名詞片語，the only book she ever finished 正好說明那本小說。only 少了 the，which only 結構不完整，an only book 不是自然的英文。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: ____, Dr. Lin explained the research results in language that everyone could follow.
explain_zh: 句首的同位語用名詞片語 A patient teacher 說明 Dr. Lin，需要冠詞。Patient teacher 少了冠詞，Being patient teacher 同樣缺冠詞，He is a patient teacher 是完整句子。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: Two of my classmates, ____, volunteered to design the poster for the charity concert.
explain_zh: 同位語直接用人名 Ben and Joy 點出前面提到的兩位同學。who Ben and Joy 缺少動詞，they are Ben and Joy 是獨立句子，being Ben and Joy 語意不自然。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: ____ permitting, the outdoor concert will begin at seven o'clock tomorrow evening.
explain_zh: Weather permitting 是固定的獨立分詞構句，意思是「天氣許可的話」，主詞是 weather，分詞是 permitting。Weather is 與 The weather has 是限定動詞需要連接詞，Weather being permitting 多了 being。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: ____ so heavily that afternoon, we decided to postpone the hiking trip to next weekend.
explain_zh: 獨立分詞構句要保留自己的主詞，這裡用虛主詞 it 加現在分詞 raining。It rained 與 It rains 是完整句子，會造成逗號連接兩個句子；Rain 缺少分詞。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: The lecture over, the students ____ out of the hall in small, chatting groups.
explain_zh: The lecture over 是獨立分詞構句，後面的主句才需要限定動詞，配合過去的情境用 streamed。streaming 與 to stream 都不是限定動詞，stream 時態不符。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: The little boy stood silently at the door, ____ full of tears and his lips trembling.
explain_zh: 獨立分詞構句可以用「所有格 + 名詞 + 補語」的形式，his eyes full of tears 正好呼應後面的 his lips trembling。he eyes 少了所有格，加了 were 就變成完整句子需要連接詞。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: ____ no bus at that late hour, we had to take a taxi all the way back to the hostel.
explain_zh: there be 句型的獨立分詞構句寫成 There being，表示原因。There was 與 There is 是完整句子，會造成逗號連接兩句；It being no bus 語法不成立。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: The guide walked ahead of the group, his right hand ____ a small red flag.
explain_zh: his right hand 是獨立分詞構句自己的主詞，手是主動舉旗，用現在分詞 holding。held 是被動或過去式，holds 是限定動詞需要連接詞，to hold 表示目的。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: All the work ____, we sat down and enjoyed a well-deserved cup of hot tea.
explain_zh: 獨立分詞構句 All the work done 表示「工作都完成後」，work 是被動所以用過去分詞 done。was done 與 is doing 都是限定動詞，會造成兩個句子直接相連；did 語態錯誤。

tag_zh: 同位語與獨立分詞構句
stem: The weather ____ suddenly that morning, the organizers moved the whole market indoors.
explain_zh: 兩個子句之間只有逗號，前面必須是獨立分詞構句；天氣先變才搬進室內，用 having changed。changed 與 has changed 是限定動詞會造成逗號連接兩句，change 形式也不對。
